# The literal `Gamma_*` degree-one quotient is generated by the eight `kappa` cells

## Outcome

Fix the canonical source presentation to be the free cellular/bar closure of
the literal operations already used in the `h=3` construction:

```text
coefficient equations and Macaulay multiples
PP/Hasse restriction and labelled reinsertion
Cartan/Weyl/root faces
objectwise K_Eq and cap-internal AugP2 faces
standard mapping cylinders and their naturality/interchange cells.
```

For this source-operation grammar, the essential-surjectivity statement is
now exact:

\[
 \boxed{
 C^{\rm grammar}_{1,\Gamma_*}/
   (C^{\rm can}_{1,\Gamma_*}+C^{\rm dark}_{1,\Gamma_*})
 \quad\text{is spanned by}\quad
 \kappa_{0012},\kappa_{0102},\kappa_{0110},\kappa_{0111},
 \kappa_{0122},\kappa_{0212},\kappa_{1112},\kappa_{2112}. }
 \tag{1}
\]

There is no ninth primitive supplied by any named literal source operation.
The proof is not a named-family union: it is a census of the indecomposable
degree-one cells in the chosen cellular grammar.  Higher cellular faces and
higher syzygies add no new `C1 -> C0` image.

This does **not** prove that the eight displayed cells are dark.  Their eight
unknown numbers

\[
                      \lambda_i=\Psi(d\kappa_i)       \tag{2}
\]

remain the exact terminal equations.  The result closes the former arbitrary
"higher multi-parent generator" loophole for the declared literal grammar;
it does not silently add a noncellular primitive operation to that grammar.

Checker:
[`verify_h3_gamma_star_source_operation_essential_surjectivity_census.py`](../computations/verify_h3_gamma_star_source_operation_essential_surjectivity_census.py).

## 1. The full selected grade

The direct-sum grade retained in the census is

```text
word                 01211222
fine packet          the six literal t*q_(v,N) P3+K2 occurrences
repeated shape       P3+K2
operation parent     response-to-AugP2 mixed orbit / K_Eq
window               2345 with literal occurrence labels
lower parent         0112 on sites 0,1,4,5
marked lower data    ordered 01, residual q45:12, reinsertion q23:21
relative degree      1.
```

The fine packet is not a coarse polynomial degree.  For each of

```text
s0*q01*q45, s0*q01*q23, s0*q01*q35,
s0*q01*q24, s0*q01*q34, s0*q01*q25,
```

the checker records the full 24-coordinate site-colour multidegree.  The six
vectors are distinct.  Replacing the cap word by the response word
`11110000 = 11:110000` changes all six fine vectors; the two words differ at
sites `P,0,2,3,4,5`.  Thus an undecorated equality between the same three edge
labels is not a map in the selected source fibre.

The operation tag is equally load-bearing.  It is the source/target
idempotent together with the word in the free operation monoid.  A response
residue operation and an `AugP2/K_Eq` operation remain different summands even
when reinsertion makes their displayed eight-site words equal.

## 2. Why the grammar has a finite degree-one census

The chosen presentation is cellular rather than an arbitrary free
resolution.  Its cells are generated as follows.

1. Coefficient equations are the algebraic zero-cells.  Macaulay
   multiplication changes polynomial multidegree but preserves the source
   word and operation parent.
2. PP/Hasse restriction, reinsertion, and Cartan/Weyl/root actions supply
   elementary labelled incidences.  Their differential is a signed sum of
   the corresponding source and target faces.
3. `K_Eq` and the cap-internal `AugP2` maps are objectwise elementary maps.
4. A standard mapping cylinder adds the cone shift of an existing generator.
   Naturality of two elementary maps adds their standard interchange square.
5. The bar/cellular total degree is additive.  Two independent successive
   comparison steps have degree at least two.  Their degree-one boundary
   faces are the elementary incidences already present in steps 2--4.

It follows inductively that an indecomposable relative-total-degree-one cell
is either an atomic incidence, a one-map cone edge, or a pairwise
interchange cell.  A cell with many geometric faces has a differential equal
to the signed linear sum of those primitive incidences; it is not a fifth
indecomposable operation-parent type.  Once `d1` is fixed, ordinary `C2` and
higher syzygies can only give relations among its columns and cannot enlarge
its image.

This is the precise reason the census is exhaustive.  It does not assert
that every imaginable higher natural transformation must exist.  Such a
transformation would be a new source operation, not a hidden consequence of
the listed ones.

## 3. Census of atomic and one-map cells

The coefficient/Macaulay cells are canonical.  Every remaining atomic or
one-map cell has one of the following exact dispositions.

| Literal primitive | Full-grade disposition | `B/Eq` reason |
|---|---|---|
| PP/Hasse restriction | same grade, dark | exhaustive rank-`126/127` local kernel |
| labelled reinsertion | same grade, dark | tied private/reduced-`Eq` incidence |
| same-shore Cartan/Weyl | same grade, dark | local operation fan |
| shore-gauged `DQ/PS` root face | same grade, dark | signless edge `u`, `delta.u=0` |
| pointed `P_f` | same grade, dark | anchor/conormal row outside `B/Eq` |
| primitive cap `p` and cap graph | same grade, dark | `Q`/target/residue rows outside `B/Eq` |
| objectwise `K_Eq` | same grade, dark | diagonal or tied `Eq` occurrence |
| shifted `gamma=-dOmega` | off grade | shifted fine and repeated grade |
| degree-four `h_v` Koszul x `Eq` | off grade | raw `2K2`, central-`Eq` operation parent |
| response/collision/one-hole faces | off grade | word, fine, and operation parent |
| collision sibling | off grade | `3K2` repeated parent |
| lower section and `dq` before placement | off grade | lower `P2` direct summand |
| cross-word cylinder edge | same grade, dark | no untied `Eq` component |
| same-object `K_Eq` cylinder | same grade, dark | tied objectwise naturality |
| residual-response KS tail transport | off grade | response-residue, not `AugP2/K_Eq`, parent |

Two points in the table prevent false extra generators.

First, the five degree-four reset cells can be placed in the cap word, but
their literal repeated shape is `2K2` and their operation parent is central
`Eq`.  Even a deliberately diagonal `Eq` placement has zero `delta.(B-Eq)`.
They do not produce a ninth selected class.

Second, the proposed residual-response Kodaira--Spencer lift is a concrete
physical operation type, not a formal exotic atom.  In its present literal
form it transports the endpoint/residue tail and has the residual-response
operation parent.  Hence it has zero projection to (1).  If a future theorem
adds a new operation-changing placement from that lift into the selected
`AugP2/K_Eq` parent, the placement is a new horizontal map; its standard
mixed `K_Eq` naturality square would have to be added to this census.  No such
source-valid placement is currently present.

## 4. The only mixed mapping-cylinder type

After the atomic cells are removed, a pairwise interchange can involve two
independent binary features:

```text
W = the cell changes the physical word/occurrence object;
E = the cell is mixed with the central K_Eq comparison.
```

Their exhaustive truth table is

| `W` | `E` | class |
|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | 0 | local/canonical |
| 1 | 0 | word-cylinder, dark |
| 0 | 1 | objectwise `Eq`, dark |
| 1 | 1 | mixed word/`K_Eq` naturality: `kappa` |

The last row is exactly the primitive two-cell already isolated by the
pointed-orbit/`K_Eq` mapping square.  A standard mapping cylinder has no
second independent interchange cell with the same ordered pair of maps.
Changing its name or displaying a different proper face does not change its
operation-parent type.

At the operation-parent level there are four cross-shore incidences

```text
g02, g03, g12, g13
```

between the two `DQ` and two `PS` parents.  After the physical shore gauge
their top vectors are the four signless `K2,2` edges.  They have rank three,
and each is killed by

\[
                         \delta=(1,1,-1,-1).           \tag{3}
\]

They pair into the `A/B` and `A/C` word sections.  Consequently a bare root
or word edge stays dark; only the reduced-`Eq` part of its `kappa`
interchange can have nonzero `Psi`.

## 5. Why there are exactly eight literal instances

The marked lower parent is the ternary word

\[
                         0112                         \tag{4}
\]

on sites `(0,1,4,5)`.  An elementary root face changes exactly one site to
one of the other two colours.  The four sites and two alternate colours give
the eight and only eight neighbours:

```text
site 0:  1112, 2112       site 1:  0012, 0212
site 4:  0102, 0122       site 5:  0110, 0111.
```

After sorting, these are precisely the eight subscripts in (1).  A
simultaneous change at two sites is not another primitive root operation: it
is a length-two Cartan/Weyl/bar composite.  Its totalization has degree at
least two and its `C1` faces are the two one-root incidences already listed.

Let `Q_Gamma` denote the quotient in (1).  Assign the formal coordinate
`e_i` to the `i`th literal `kappa` and zero to every canonical, off-grade, or
dark primitive.  The eight `e_i` have rank eight in the free census.  Since
every degree-one primitive maps to one of these nine possibilities (zero or
one of the eight `e_i`), the natural map

\[
                \operatorname{span}\{\kappa_i\}_{i=1}^8
                    \longrightarrow Q_{\Gamma_*}     \tag{5}
\]

is surjective.  Relations in the physical source may lower the dimension of
`Q_Gamma`; they cannot require a ninth generator.

## 6. What remains for the proof

The old unbounded "perhaps a higher syzygy adds a new bright column" fork is
gone once the source is represented by this canonical literal grammar.  The
remaining test is finite:

```text
prove lambda_i = Psi(d kappa_i) = 0 for all eight literal lower words
    -> Psi extends through the entire grammar degree-one image;

find one lambda_i != 0
    -> that same physical mixed cell is the unique projection-level filler;
       repair its q/anchor/W/residue/ridge proper faces.
```

Physical `q=M-ainc` remains compatible with the extended covector but does
not decide any `lambda_i`.  Likewise, this `h=3` census does not provide the
spectator-tail monoidality needed for an all-`h` theorem.

## Scope

This is an exact rational theorem for the canonical fixed-grade source
presentation generated by the literal operation list at the top of the
note.  It includes the complete four-site local category, full
word/fine/repeated/operation grading, and standard cellular/mapping-cylinder
closure.  It is not yet an exact finite full GHZ tensor, does not construct
the missing `kappa` family, and does not prove pure-target normalization or
all mixed output-word equations.  Those tasks begin after the eight values
in (2) are obtained.

python3 -I -S computations/verify_h3_gamma_star_source_operation_essential_surjectivity_census.py
